name: Simulated board
description: A pretend soundboard held in memory. It behaves like a real one: it clamps values to its range, rounds levels to 0.1 dB and reports what it actually set. Used for tests and for trying Skillfully without a board.

boardChanges.description: Changes the pretend board makes by itself, as if someone moved a fader at the desk. For tests.

sceneRecall.description: Recalls a pretend scene: every send into bus 1 jumps to one level, in a single message. For tests.

answerDelayMs.description: How long the pretend board takes to answer a command.
